"Inserts after the cutover get no guess: no sidecar entry means the inverse leaves the offset empty and marks the row unrestorable, because defaulting to the server zone would invent exactly the local time you describe. For updates, I'd skip a separate invalidation hook and make the check self-contained instead. The sidecar stores the UTC value it was paired with, and the inverse re ... . With you on that count as a sign-off input. A down step that opens with '1,904 rows will lose their zone' invites a real decision; one that just says 'reversible' invites a rubber stamp." [e8ce8398]
